test_override_virtual_functions: test that Python subclasses can override C++ virtual functions exposed via pybind11
test_alias_delay_initialization: test that pybind11 trampoline classes are only initialized when a Python subclass is created
test_move_support_noncopyable: test that non-copyable C++ objects can be returned from overridden Python virtual functions
test_inherited_virtuals: test that Python subclasses can override virtual functions across multi-level C++ inheritance hierarchies
test_python_override_cache: test that pybind11 correctly caches and resolves Python function overrides across repeated calls
